title: Scyap's Charcoal Block Mod
description: This mod adds block of charcoal in Minecraft, as well as block of burning charcoal and block of wood ash
body:
# YouTube Link:
<iframe width="560" height="315" src="https://www.youtube-nocookie.com/embed/Niu-XfjWdiI" title="YouTube video player" frameborder="0" allow="accelerometer; autoplay; clipboard-write; encrypted-media; gyroscope; picture-in-picture; web-share" allowfullscreen></iframe>

# Mod Information:
This mod adds the block of charcoal, block of burning charcoal and block of ash into Minecraft


Block of Charcoal
- Turns into Block of Burning Charcoal when clicked with a flint and steel or a fire charge.
- Craftable by putting a charcoal item in each slot of a 3x3 crafting grid.
- Able to fuel furnaces and smelt 80 items per charcoal block (Same rate as coal blocks).

Block of Burning Charcoal
- Will fall in mid-air.
- Will emit light.
- Emits "fire" particles periodically (Purely for cosmetics)
- Turns into Block of Ash when touches water.
- Turns back into Block of Charcoal when clicked with a shovel tool.

Block of Wood Ash
- Will fall in mid-air.
